title: Forensic analyst: Sara Duterte’s unexplained wealth could be as high as P1.5-B | The wRap
summary: Today’s headlines: Sara Duterte, 2028 presidential race, Henry Aguda

blocks.text: Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:’

items: Duterte’s undeclared wealth may reach P1.5 billion — forensic financial analyst

blocks.text: Financial forensic analyst Alexander Cabrera says Vice President Sara Duterte’s undeclared wealth from 2022 to 2025 could reach P1.5-billion if his estimates are ‘not conservative.’

items: Survey: Sara Duterte leads 2028 presidential preference list

blocks.text: A Pulse Asia survey reveals Vice President Sara Duterte remains the leading candidate for the 2028 presidential race.

items: Prosecution forgoes plan to ask Sara Duterte to testify in own trial

blocks.text: The prosecution team in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte drops its plan to call her to the witness stand.

items: Marcos confirms DICT chief Aguda’s resignation

blocks.text: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. confirms he has accepted the resignation of Information and Communications Technology Chief Henry Aguda.

items: Trump calls for replacing Ukraine’s Zelenskyy in tussle over diesel deal with Russia

blocks.text: US President Donald Trump calls for Ukraine to replace President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and criticized Ukraine’s attacks on Russian oil facilities. – Rappler.com
